access_links.label: Scottish EPC Register: search by RRN or postcode, data extracts

access_note: Individual searches only; automated access to the register is not allowed, and a data extracts section is offered.
description: The Scottish Energy Performance Certificate Register holds Energy Performance Certificates and recommendations reports, action plans, Display Energy Certificates and advisory reports for buildings in Scotland. Users can retrieve a current valid document by its 20-digit report reference number or, for EPCs, by postcode, find EPC assessors, Section 63 advisors and DEC assessors, and consult a data extracts section; automated software access to the register is not allowed. Not all EPCs are on the register because central lodgement was phased in: it holds new buildings with a building warrant application after 9 January 2013, dwellings sold or let to a new tenant after 1 December 2008, and non-domestic buildings sold or let and public buildings from January 2013. Coverage: Scotland. Access: free individual search and data extracts. Licence: register terms. Caveats: only current valid documents are shown, and older buildings without a recent transaction are missing. Simulation uses are building-level energy ratings and features for Scottish stock and retrofit models. Related records: the England and Wales EPC register.
